Move latest to the proven local-llm index when dispatched with promote_latest

local-llm's manifest is to name docker.io/assistos/local-llm:latest, the
multi-arch index, so DGX Spark hosts pull the arm64 child and x86 hosts the
reused amd64 image.

The workflow gains a promote_latest input, false by default. The index job
now checks that the digest of the exact bytes it verified is the digest it
hands on, and outputs it. A promote job, which runs only when the input is
true and after the index job, moves latest to that exact digest after
checking the registry bytes against it, then reads latest back and requires
the same digest. Nothing else in the workflow names latest; the candidate
tag stays per run and is never overwritten.

Report upstream error metadata and reasoning liveness from the OpenAI provider

HTTP failures and in-band error payloads now carry the upstream status,
parsed body and rate-limit headers, and streamed errors record whether
output had already started, so gateways can classify retry, fallback and
quota scope. Streamed reasoning deltas are reported as thinking_delta
chunks, never as answer text, so a caller can tell a working model from
a silent one.

Move latest to the proven local-llm index when dispatched with promote_latest

local-llm's manifest is to name docker.io/assistos/local-llm:latest, the
multi-arch index, so DGX Spark hosts pull the arm64 child and x86 hosts the
reused amd64 image.

The workflow gains a promote_latest input, false by default. The index job
now checks that the digest of the exact bytes it verified is the digest it
hands on, and outputs it. A promote job, which runs only when the input is
true and after the index job, moves latest to that exact digest after
checking the registry bytes against it, then reads latest back and requires
the same digest. Nothing else in the workflow names latest; the candidate
tag stays per run and is never overwritten.

HTTP failures and in-band error payloads now carry the upstream status,
parsed body and rate-limit headers, and streamed errors record whether
output had already started, so gateways can classify retry, fallback and
quota scope. Streamed reasoning deltas are reported as thinking_delta
chunks, never as answer text, so a caller can tell a working model from
a silent one.

Move latest to the proven local-llm index when dispatched with promote_latest

local-llm's manifest is to name docker.io/assistos/local-llm:latest, the
multi-arch index, so DGX Spark hosts pull the arm64 child and x86 hosts the
reused amd64 image.

The workflow gains a promote_latest input, false by default. The index job
now checks that the digest of the exact bytes it verified is the digest it
hands on, and outputs it. A promote job, which runs only when the input is
true and after the index job, moves latest to that exact digest after
checking the registry bytes against it, then reads latest back and requires
the same digest. Nothing else in the workflow names latest; the candidate
tag stays per run and is never overwritten.

Report upstream error metadata and reasoning liveness from the OpenAI provider

HTTP failures and in-band error payloads now carry the upstream status,
parsed body and rate-limit headers, and streamed errors record whether
output had already started, so gateways can classify retry, fallback and
quota scope. Streamed reasoning deltas are reported as thinking_delta
chunks, never as answer text, so a caller can tell a working model from
a silent one.
